lessonContent.explanation: Point to each object one at a time. Say one number name for each item. The last number you count tells how many items there are in total!
lessonContent.keyTip: 💡 Tip: Tap on each item to place a counter sticker so you never count the same item twice!

exercises.instructionEn: Count the pictures. How many stars are there?
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga larawan. Ilan ang mga tala?
exercises.questionEn: How many stars are in the box?
exercises.hint: Touch each star from left to right: one, two, three!

exercises.instructionEn: Count the pictures. How many cans are in the box?
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga larawan. Ilan ang mga lata sa kahon?
exercises.questionEn: How many cans are in the box?
exercises.questionTl: Ilan ang mga lata sa kahon?
exercises.hint: Count the row of cans starting from the tallest one: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9.

exercises.instructionEn: Count the pictures. How many boxes (cartons) are in the frame?
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga larawan. Ilan ang mga karton sa kahon?
exercises.questionEn: How many cartons are in the box?
exercises.questionTl: Ilan ang mga karton sa kahon?
exercises.hint: Count all four 3D blocks inside the frame.

titleTl: Pagsasanay A: Piliin ang tamang bilang
subtitle: Multiple Choice Counting (Numbers 10 to 70)

lessonContent.conceptTitle: Lesson: Counting Rows and Adding Extras
lessonContent.explanation: When counting many items, look at how they are arranged in neat rows. Count by whole rows first, then add the leftovers!
lessonContent.keyTip: 💡 Tip: Look for complete rows of 10 or 12 to count much faster!

visualExample.groupingText: Top row has 9 + bottom row has 3 = 12 Yo-yos 🪀

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the correct number of items in the picture.
exercises.instructionTl: Piliin ang tamang bilang ng mga nasa larawan at isulat ang sagot.
exercises.hint: Row 1 has 9 yo-yos. Row 2 has 3 yo-yos. 9 + 3 = 12.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the correct count of balloons / light bulbs in the picture.
exercises.instructionTl: Piliin ang tamang bilang ng mga nasa larawan at isulat ang sagot.
exercises.questionEn: Count all the hanging bulbs / balloons:
exercises.hint: 3 rows of 11 (33) plus 9 in the bottom row = 42 in total.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the correct count of school backpacks.
exercises.instructionTl: Piliin ang tamang bilang ng mga nasa larawan at isulat ang sagot.
exercises.questionEn: Count all the yellow school bags:
exercises.hint: 4 rows of 13 = 52 bags. Add 10 bags in the last row = 62 bags.

titleEn: Activity 3: Count and Choose the Correct Number
titleTl: Gawain 3: Pagbilang at Pagpili ng Tamang Bilang
subtitle: Simple Multiple-Choice Counting Practice for Grade 1

lessonContent.explanation: Count the objects in each group carefully. You can tap each picture to put a star sticker on it! Once you know the total, tap the matching number button below.
lessonContent.keyTip: 💡 Quick Tip: Count row by row! Then tap the big matching number (A, B, or C).

exercises.instructionEn: Count the sweet strawberries and choose the correct number.
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga strawberry at piliin ang tamang bilang.
exercises.questionEn: 1. How many strawberries are in the patch?
exercises.hint: Count the top row (8) and bottom row (4): 8 + 4 = 12 strawberries.

exercises.instructionEn: Count the pineapples in the grid and choose the correct number.
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga pinya at piliin ang tamang sagot.
exercises.questionEn: 2. How many pineapples are there in total?
exercises.hint: There are 10 rows of 5 pineapples each. Skip-count by 5s: 5, 10, 15... up to 50!

exercises.instructionEn: Count the orchard apples and choose the matching number.
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga mansanas at piliin ang tamang sagot.
exercises.questionEn: 3. How many apples are in the orchard?
exercises.hint: There are 7 rows of 10 apples (= 70) plus 1 single apple at the bottom = 71 apples!

exercises.instructionEn: Count all the strawberries in the box and choose the correct number.
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga strawberry sa kahon at piliin ang tamang sagot.
exercises.questionEn: 4. How many strawberries are inside the box?
exercises.questionTl: 4. Ilan ang mga strawberry sa kahon?
exercises.hint: Top two rows have 9 + 9 = 18. Add 7 in the bottom row: 18 + 7 = 25 strawberries.

subtitle: Extra Practice: Quick Counting & Skip Counting

lessonContent.explanation: You can count groups faster by skip counting! Try counting flowers in pairs (2, 4, 6...) or pencils in bundles of 5.

exercises.instructionEn: Skip count the colorful blooming flowers in pairs of 2.
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga bulaklak ng dala-dalawa.
exercises.questionEn: How many flowers are in the garden?
exercises.questionTl: Ilan ang mga bulaklak sa hardin?

exercises.instructionEn: Count the school pencils in groups of 5 and write the number.
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga lapis at isulat ang bilang.
exercises.questionEn: How many colored pencils are on the desk?
exercises.questionTl: Ilan ang mga lapis sa mesa?
